projects.title: Lumina Estudio Láser
projects.brief_description: Informational site for a tattoo removal studio.
projects.full_description:
**How do I grow my business's digital presence?** That was the question the owner of Lumina Estudio Láser GDL wanted to answer when we started working together.

The business relied mainly on social media and word of mouth, so it needed a digital presence that would **convey trust**, explain its services clearly, and make it easier to attract new clients.

I built a website with a modern design, a **mobile-first** approach, **SEO** optimization, and **high performance**. The experience was designed to resolve users' most common questions and guide them naturally toward getting in touch through strategic calls to action.

This project reflects my approach as a developer: _building solutions that not only look good, but answer **real business goals** and deliver results._

projects.title: Lumina Estudio Láser (Admin System)
projects.brief_description: Client and sales management system for a tattoo removal studio.
projects.full_description:
**How do you replace an Excel-based administrative process with a platform designed to grow alongside the business?** That was the challenge after the launch of the Lumina Estudio Láser GDL website.

I built a **custom web application** to centralize the management of clients, records, sessions, treatments, promotions, and reports. The solution removed the dependency on multiple spreadsheets, simplified administrative tasks, and made each patient's **complete history** accessible from a single platform.

This project reflects my approach as a developer: _understanding the business's processes and turning them into tools that improve **efficiency** and enable growth._

projects.title: Portfolio
projects.brief_description: Personal portfolio showcasing professional experience, skills, and technical projects with engaging design.
projects.full_description:
**How do you present your professional experience in a way that truly reflects who you are as a developer?** That was the question I asked myself when designing my personal portfolio.

I wanted to create something that went beyond a traditional résumé—a platform where recruiters, clients, and fellow developers could explore my experience, technical skills, projects, certifications, and education through a clear, engaging, and interactive experience.

I designed and developed a portfolio with a **modern visual identity**, a **carefully crafted** user experience, a **responsive design**, subtle animations, and an **information architecture** focused on highlighting my strengths while making it easy to navigate my professional journey.

This project reflects my approach as a developer: _combining design, user experience, and software engineering to build products that **communicate value**, inspire confidence, and authentically represent both my technical expertise and my problem-solving mindset._
